description.value:
As a bonus action, you can enter a synchronized stance with one willing ally within 10 feet of you for 1 minute. While the stance lasts, once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack, that ally gains advantage on its next attack against the same target before the end of your next turn; likewise, once per turn when the chosen ally hits a creature with an attack, you gain advantage on your next attack against that same target before the end of your next turn.

The stance ends early if either of you is incapacitated or killed, or if the ally is ever more than 10 feet from you. You must complete a long rest before using this feature again.

At 11th level, the ally need only stay within 30 feet of you to benefit, and at 17th level, within 60 feet.
